name: Bug report / 问题报告

title: ''
labels: bug
---

## Behavior / 行为

What happened, and what did you expect? / 实际表现与预期是什么？

## Environment / 环境

- Commit / 提交：
- macOS or Linux version / 系统版本：
- Host architecture / 宿主架构：
- Build mode and exact command / 构建模式与完整命令：
- Guest input versions or hashes, if relevant / 相关客体版本或摘要：

## Reproduction / 复现

Minimal steps and a short sanitized diagnostic excerpt / 最小步骤与脱敏诊断片段。

Do not attach firmware, private guest databases, credentials, or memory dumps.
请勿附固件、私人客体数据库、凭据或内存转储。

## Validation scope / 验证范围

Host test, headless guest, Cocoa window, or physical mouse? / 主机测试、无窗口客体、Cocoa 窗口还是实际鼠标？
